footer_bottom: SafeHaven · Yakhelwe bafati nemantfombatane baseNingizimu Afrika
hero_desc: I-SafeHaven ihlanganisa tindzawo tekuphephela, seluleko semtsetfo, kanye nemuntfu longakhuluma naye endzaweni yinye, leyakhelwe iNingizimu Afrika, ngetilimi lotikhulumako.
how_1_text: Sesha tindzawo tekuphephela, emakliniki, kanye nemahhovisi elusito lwemtsetfo ngesifundza bese ubona kahle kutsi ngiyiphi lenika ini ngaphambi kwekutsi uhambe.
how_2_text: Tincwadzi letisebentiswa kalula tichaza imiyalo yekuphephela, kubika budlova, kanye naloko umtsetfo waseNingizimu Afrika lokuvumelako kutsi ukwente.
how_3_text: Konkhe kulesi sayithi kungavalwa msinyane nge-Quick Exit, futsi akukho lokugcinwako nobe lokulandzelelwako lapha.

cta_desc: Konkhe ku-SafeHaven kumahhala, kuyimfihlo, futsi kwakhelwe kusebenta ngisho nangekuxhumana lokumnyantane.
